azanDua.title: Du'aa After Azan
azanDua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
azanDua.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and favour, and raise him to the honoured station You have promised him.
azanDua.oromo: Yaa Rabbi, Gooftaa waamicha (azaanaa) guutuu kanaafi salaata dhaabbataa kanaa, Muhammad (SAW) araarsaafi ol'aantummaa isaaf kenni; sadarkaa faarfamaa ati waadaa isaaf galte sanas isa gahi.
